claims.summary: Observed: astrid:llm implements a deterministic scanner distinguishing raw text from model control markers by syntactic context.
claims.disposition: Verified at source SHA 902a0358 (complete 1-1048). scan_known_model_control_markers (L114-144) walks bytes, matches KNOWN_MODEL_CONTROL_MARKERS via longest_exact_known_model_control_marker_at (L97-112), and classifies each via reference_syntax (L49-60). Markers are transport tokens (fallback_contracts.rs L159-180: <end_of_turn>, [INST], <|im_end|>...), not [SYSTEM]/[USER].

claims.summary: Observed: scan_known_model_control_markers (L114) reconstructs a clean remainder while tracking marker metadata.
claims.disposition: Verified L114-144: builds `remainder` String plus Vec<KnownModelControlMarkerMatch>; a marker's bytes are re-emitted to remainder only when reference_syntax.is_some() (L129-131), else stripped; non-marker bytes are always copied. Cited function line L114 is exact.

claims.summary: Observed: exact_reference_delimiter_syntax (L199) detects quoted vs grouped context informing preserve/strip.
claims.disposition: Verified L199-229 + pair table L153-197: QuotedExactKnownToken for matching quote pairs, GroupedExactKnownToken for bracket pairs; preserve/strip decided at L129. Contradiction preserved: the report's [SYSTEM] is not a known marker, and brackets around a bare token map to GroupedExactKnownToken, not a quoted token; the illustration diverges from the real transport-token allowlist.

claims.summary: Snag: first_word_after (L89) uses split_whitespace + char filter to identify relation verbs (L64-85).
claims.disposition: Verified L89-96 (split_whitespace, trims non-alphanumeric except underscore, lowercases first non-empty word) and the 18-verb allowlist L67-84 matched by followed_by_explicit_exact_token_relation (L64-86). Citations exact.

claims.summary: Snag: a multi-word predicate (e.g. [MARKER] behaves like a ghost) makes first_word_after capture 'behaves' but the relation logic ignores modifiers, risking inconsistent preservation.
claims.disposition: Contradiction preserved: source keys preservation solely on the first following word (L64-86; comment L62-63 states preceding/subsequent words are intentionally uninspected), so modifiers after a relation verb cannot create inconsistency; preservation is deterministic. Covered by tests.rs control_marker_cleanup_uses_only_the_first_finite_relation_word (L2605) and multi-word predicate `<end_of_turn> behaves as a named boundary.` (L2945).

claims.summary: Test 1 (Contextual Preservation): "The prompt [SYSTEM] is active" should hit QuotedExactKnownToken (L174) and keep the marker in remainder.
claims.disposition: Concern (quoted preservation) verified at tests.rs L1995: real marker "<end_of_turn>" -> QuotedExactKnownToken, preserved. New regression grounds two corrections: (a) [SYSTEM] is not a known marker; (b) reference_syntax resolves delimiter syntax (L50) BEFORE the relation fallback (L53), so a quote-adjacent marker then `is` -> Quoted, an unquoted marker then `is` -> ExplicitExactKnownTokenRelation. Her sentence-quoted example is relation, not quoted.

claims.summary: Test 2 (Relation Trigger): [SYSTEM] behaves as a helper -> followed_by_explicit_exact_token_relation (L64) true, marker preserved.
claims.disposition: Verified at tests.rs L2932 with real marker: `<end_of_turn> behaves as a named boundary.` -> ExplicitExactKnownTokenRelation, remainder unchanged; mechanism identical (first word `behaves` is allowlisted). Contradiction preserved: [SYSTEM] is not in KNOWN_MODEL_CONTROL_MARKERS, so the literal string matches no marker and passes through unchanged; grounding uses the real transport token.

claims.summary: Suggested Next: examine generate_dialogue (L695) for how remainder is integrated into the final response buffer.
claims.disposition: Read-only continuation pointer (Tier 1, her agency); no steward mutation. Grounded correction: generate_dialogue (L695-1048) does not call the sanitizer directly; the remainder is consumed by sanitize_model_control_markers (L519-520) invoked from response-normalization helpers (L558, L634) and the fallback contract path (fallback_contracts.rs L234), plus autonomous/state.rs L3253.
